summary: The current source shows two defects that account for the reported failures: SetPayload leaves an existing URL’s value unchanged, and CloneAndUnref omits payloads when cloning a shared rep with exactly one entry.
hypotheses: StatusRep::SetPayload returns when a URL already exists instead of replacing its payload.
StatusRep::CloneAndUnref drops the sole payload when copying a shared rep, so subsequent erase operations cannot find it.
